name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden
description: A 240-acre botanical garden with the iconic glasshouse, ancient trees, a lake and the best early-morning walk in south Bengaluru.

name: Cubbon Park
address: Kasturba Road, Sampangi Rama Nagar, Bengaluru 560001
description: Bengaluru's green lung in the middle of the city, ideal for a shaded walk, a lazy picnic and an easy connection to Church Street.

name: Bangalore Palace
description: A Tudor-style royal residence with carved wood interiors, vintage photographs and sprawling gardens.

name: Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace
description: A compact 18th-century palace with ornate teak pillars, frescoes and a quiet garden in the old city.

name: ISKCON Temple Bangalore
address: Hare Krishna Hill, Chord Road, Rajajinagar, Bengaluru 560010
description: A hilltop Krishna temple complex known for its grand architecture, evening aarti and panoramic city views.

name: Bull Temple
description: A 16th-century Dravidian temple home to one of the city's most beloved Nandi statues.

name: UB City Mall
description: Luxury retail, polished restaurants and a rooftop-style plaza that feels a world away from the city traffic.

name: Church Street
description: A pedestrian-friendly strip of cafes, bookstores, pubs and late-night energy in the heart of the city.

name: Brigade Road
description: One of Bengaluru's original shopping streets, packed with stores, street food and quick access to Church Street.

name: Commercial Street
description: A bustling bargain-hunting street for clothes, jewellery, accessories and classic Bengaluru street snacks.

name: Indiranagar 100 Feet Road
description: The neighbourhood's main dining and shopping artery, lined with cafes, regional restaurants and indie boutiques.

name: Toit Brewpub
description: A Bengaluru institution for craft beer, wood-fired pizza and loud, happy evenings across three floors.

name: Third Wave Coffee, Indiranagar
description: A reliable specialty-coffee spot with good Wi-Fi, long tables and a calm weekday work-from-cafe vibe.

name: Rameshwaram Cafe, Indiranagar
description: A wildly popular quick-service cafe famous for ghee podi idli, filter coffee and perpetual queues.

name: Dyu Art Cafe
description: A leafy courtyard cafe in an old bungalow, made for slow breakfasts, sketching and quiet conversation.

name: Koramangala 5th Block
description: A walkable pocket of cafes, restaurants, startup offices and nightlife that sums up young Bengaluru.

name: Empire Restaurant
description: Late-night biryani, kebabs and quick service that has fed Bengaluru's night owls for decades.

name: MTR (Mavalli Tiffin Rooms)
description: The original Mavalli Tiffin Rooms, serving rava idli, masala dosa and filter coffee since 1924.

name: Vidyarthi Bhavan
address: 32 Gandhi Bazaar Main Road, Basavanagudi, Bengaluru 560004
description: A legendary old-school breakfast room where the benne masala dosa is crisp, buttery and worth the wait.

name: CTR (Shri Sagar)
description: A tiny, beloved dosa institution in Malleshwaram known for its crisp benne dosa and busy morning rush.

name: Nandi Hills
description: A hilltop sunrise escape about 60 km from Bengaluru, with cool air, old fort walls and sweeping valley views.

name: Bannerghatta National Park
description: A family-friendly wildlife park with a safari, butterfly park, zoo and rescue centre on the city's southern edge.

name: Wonderla Bangalore
description: A large amusement and water park with high-thrill rides, wave pools and plenty of shade for a full-day family outing.

name: Phoenix Marketcity
description: A big-format mall with international brands, a food court, cinema and enough air-conditioning to survive a hot afternoon.

name: HAL Aerospace Museum
address: HAL Old Airport Road, Konena Agrahara, Bengaluru 560017
description: An outdoor-and-indoor museum of Indian aviation history with aircraft, engines and interactive exhibits.

name: Visvesvaraya Industrial & Technological Museum
address: Kasturba Road, Sampangi Rama Nagar, Bengaluru 560001
description: A hands-on science museum next to Cubbon Park with engines, space exhibits and a popular dinosaur gallery.

name: National Gallery of Modern Art
description: A calm heritage mansion showing modern and contemporary Indian art, with a peaceful garden cafe.

name: Ulsoor Lake
description: A central lake with a walking path, boating and quiet corners that feel surprisingly removed from the traffic.

name: Sankey Tank
description: A pleasant neighbourhood lake with a shaded loop walk and benches facing the water at sunset.

name: St. Mary's Basilica
address: Msgr. F. Noronha Road, Shivajinagar, Bengaluru 560051
description: A Gothic-style basilica with stained glass, quiet pews and the lively St. Mary's Feast every September.

name: Bangalore Fort
description: Remains of a 16th-century fort tucked behind KR Market, with stone walls, a gateway and a small museum.

name: Rangoli Metro Art Center
address: MG Road Metro Station, Shivajinagar, Bengaluru 560001
description: A free public art space under MG Road metro station with changing exhibitions, murals and a small amphitheatre.

name: Blossom Book House
description: A much-loved independent bookstore with three packed floors of new and second-hand books.

name: Truffles
description: A no-frills burger and steak joint that consistently draws a queue of students and office crowds.
